records.definition: SELECT b.id AS business_id, count(s.id) AS total_sales, sum(s.total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN sales s ON b.id = s.business_id GROUP BY b.id
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.stock_quantity, p.reorder_level, CASE WHEN p.stock_quantity <= p.reorder_level THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'OK' END AS status FROM products p
SELECT p.id, p.full_name, p.email, p.role FROM profiles p WHERE p.is_active = true
